execution_path.fact: The server container receives PYTHONPATH=/work/input/capture_bootstrap:/work/input and starts python3 -m sglang.launch_server.
The same container then runs python3 /work/input/exact_runner.py through docker exec.
Its unconditional install() executes in every Python interpreter that inherits PYTHONPATH, including the request runner as well as the SGLang server.

localized_defect: The request-runner interpreter installs a second OffsetTapCapture over the shared root and runs its atexit close with zero rows, producing a pass terminal that can overwrite the server observer terminal after the request process exits. The persisted observer error and zero-row pass terminal are therefore mutually inconsistent lifecycle outputs, not an interpretable capture.
repair: Install the observer only when argv[0] identifies the SGLang launch_server process. The runner remains uninstrumented; no request payload, checkpoint, training, holdout, or endpoint contract changes.
